title: Core: AS2 switch/case with fall-through
description: Test compilation of switch/case: switch(x) { case 1: trace(1); break; case 2: trace(2); break; default: trace(0); }. Test fall-through: case without break. Test string switch: switch(s) { case 'a': ... }. Test switch with complex expressions. Test that switch emits ActionEquals2 (0x49 or 0x66) for each case comparison. Test empty switch, switch with only default.
